description: Tech Ridge Center is a thriving 240,013 square foot community shopping center strategically positioned at the intersection of two major Austin thoroughfares including Interstate 35, serving one of the city's most densely populated and affluent areas. Anchored by the popular Texas grocery chain H.E.B., along with Baylor Scott & White medical facilities and the entertainment destination Pinstack, the center has established itself as a vital hub for the North Austin community since its development. The property benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility in the rapidly growing Austin-Round Rock market, drawing over 4.2 million visitors annually who come for its convenient mix of grocery, healthcare, dining, and entertainment options. The center's location in the Tech Ridge area places it at the heart of Austin's northern expansion, surrounded by a prosperous residential base with household incomes averaging over $106,000 and home values exceeding $513,000. With three available spaces totaling opportunities within its 240,013 square feet, Tech Ridge Center continues to evolve as a premier community destination that serves the daily needs of North Austin's thriving population.
